action.cleanup.user-temp.desc: Deletes files older than 24 hours in the user temp folder (%TEMP%). Files in use are skipped and counted; junctions are never followed. Irreversible.
action.cleanup.windows-temp.desc: Deletes files older than 24 hours in %SystemRoot%\Temp. Requires administrator. Files in use are skipped and counted; junctions are never followed. Irreversible.
action.storage.optimize-analyze.desc: Runs Optimize-Volume -Analyze on the system drive and shows the report. Read-only. Requires administrator.
action.storage.optimize-retrim: Run TRIM on the system drive (SSD)
action.storage.optimize-retrim.desc: Runs Optimize-Volume -ReTrim only when the system drive is an SSD. Refused on HDD or unknown media; defragmentation is out of scope. Requires administrator. Cannot be undone (it only tells the SSD which blocks are free; no user data changes).
action.integrity.sfc-verify.desc: Runs sfc /verifyonly: checks protected Windows files without repairing anything. Requires administrator. Duration varies.
action.integrity.sfc-scannow.desc: Runs sfc /scannow: checks and replaces corrupted protected files. Requires administrator. Irreversible. Duration varies.
action.integrity.dism-checkhealth.desc: Runs DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /CheckHealth: quick check for corruption already recorded. Changes nothing. Requires administrator.
action.integrity.dism-scanhealth.desc: Runs DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /ScanHealth: full component store scan, no repair. Requires administrator. Duration varies.
action.integrity.dism-restorehealth.desc: Runs DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth: repairs the component store and may download files from Windows Update. Requires administrator. Irreversible. Duration varies.
action.integrity.chkdsk-scan.desc: Runs chkdsk <system drive> /scan: online file system check, no /f and no restart. Requires administrator. Duration varies.
